ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In this diagram, what structure does G represent?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This diagram is a side sectional view of the human head and brain, with multiple letters labeling different brain structures. The letter G is located at the upper left of the image, and its indicator line points to the largest, upper, arc-shaped brain region inside the cranial cavity, rather than the smaller cerebellum at the posterior lower part or the brainstem below. Reasoning: In human brain anatomy, the main brain structure that occupies most of the cranial cavity and is located above is the cerebrum, namely the cerebrum. Therefore, G represents cerebrum.
